thread:
ops-alerts-bot: ALERT: hosted-usw2 pool-9 | admission queue p95=480s, headroom <6% for 12m. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dash/pool-9 · alert_id=ALRT-17955
jen: I see a sudden spike in embedding/batch jobs from tenant-x. routing shows more spillover into pool-9 in the last 10m.
sam: Autoscaler hit 85% and then stayed. Might be refill lag + image-pull latency. I'll check node provisioning events.
maria: Checking network/egress: SNAT ephemeral ports at ~82% over the last 15m, retries visible. Could be causing proxy backoffs and request pileups.
kai: Short-term mitigation idea: enforce per-tenant fairshare soft-throttle for noisy tenants (embedding-heavy) and raise kv-cache TTL for common prefixes. Low-risk and quick.
donna: If we need headroom immediately we can scale pool-9 +4 GPUs, but that has cost impact. Finance ok to approve temporary bump for incident window? cc @finance (not in channel).
infra-bot: scale request queued -> to confirm: run `poolctl scale pool-9 +4 --reason "incident-1795558888"` to start expansion.
jen: Also propose rotating 15% of non-SLA traffic to euw2 burst pool while we stabilize. That reduces pressure immediately.
sam: I'll run a small canary of cache TTL bump first (30s->180s) at 10% traffic to validate no regressions: `redwoodctl config set pool-9 kv_cache_ttl=180 --subset=canary`
maria: Image registry latency looked fine but the SNAT note stands. If ephemeral ports exhaust, we'll see more TCP retries -> admission pileup. Recommend opening INF ticket for SNAT capacity and enabling per-pod SNAT as fallback.
kai: If scale takes longer than 3m we should: 1) route low-priority jobs to euw2 2) enable model-downgrade (quantized) for non-enterprise tenants to halve token cost.
donna: Agreed. Plan: (A) scale +4, (B) cache canary 10% -> 100% if healthy, (C) 15% routing to euw2, (D) soft fairshare ratecap for tenant-x. Who takes each?
sam: I'll kick off cache canary and create the ratecap rule. Posting commands in thread once started.
jen: Rerouting command: `trafficctl reroute --from pool-9 --to pool-12 --filter 'tenant!=enterprise' --percent 15` — rolling now (15%).
ops-alerts-bot: Update: scale initiated, estimated hot allocation time ~2m; predicted headroom +12% post-scale. Monitor p95 and admission headroom.
maria: Filed infra ticket INF-8923 for SNAT capacity buffer and per-pod SNAT evaluation. If SNAT spikes again we may have to pause non-essential image pulls.
infra-bot: Event: ALERT_ACK by sam at 1795558905. Scale event id s-9912 created.
sam: Cache canary applied at 1795558920 -> 10% traffic. Ratecap rule for tenant-x set to 0.6 of baseline.
ops-alerts-bot: Metrics update: 3m after mitigations qlen p95 down to ~130s, headroom now 9%.
donna: Good progress. Action items for post-incident: 1) tighter per-tenant admission thresholds and playbook, 2) SNAT capacity buffer + per-pod option, 3) autoscaler prewarm safety (avoid refill cliffs).
sam: Will keep monitoring and will escalate if p95 creeps back up. Closing window target 1795559050 - keep thread updated.
jen: Thanks everyone — keeping watch.
